title: Duplicate group invite emails around the database migration
text:
A handful of beta testers received the same "you've been matched" email twice around the October 17 database migration window.

Daniel suspects the notification job was replayed after the migration finished. Need to:

* Check the job logs from that night
* Make sending idempotent (store a sent marker per group and student)

Low frequency, but it looks sloppy right before the public launch.
